man has no Tg semantic target; man anchor axis is N/A, retained ordinary control.

Conventional SYNOPSIS ordering; original warning-recovery source remains. Tree must prove actual Nm/Fo BODY ancestry.
The table directly precedes the next It/El execution node; tree receipt required, not inferred from source spelling.
Current declared layout is independently in tree; following-table remains a distinct owner.
Native opaque-payload expected only; actual source recovery invocation/budget acceptance is Uncovered until producer harness runs.
